data.long_description:
Discover refined living in this exceptional 6-bedroom villa with a maid's room, located in the prestigious Autograph Collection at DAMAC Hills. Offering an expansive 5,995 sq. ft. of thoughtfully designed living space, this home blends modern architecture, premium finishes, and functional elegance to create the perfect sanctuary for families seeking comfort and sophistication.

The villa welcomes you with spacious open-plan living and dining areas enhanced by floor-to-ceiling windows that fill the interiors with natural light. The contemporary kitchen is beautifully appointed with high-quality cabinetry, sleek countertops, and generous storage, making it ideal for everyday living and entertaining alike.

Each of the six generously sized bedrooms is designed for privacy and relaxation, featuring built-in wardrobes and luxurious en-suite bathrooms. The master suite serves as a private retreat, complete with a walk-in closet and a spa-inspired bathroom. A separate maid's room adds convenience and flexibility for modern family living.

Step outside to a private landscaped garden, offering ample space for outdoor dining, children's play, or simply unwinding in a peaceful setting. Covered parking and elegant finishes throughout further enhance the villa's appeal.

Residents of the Autograph Collection enjoy access to the outstanding lifestyle amenities of DAMAC Hills, including the Trump International Golf Club Dubai, lush parks, walking and cycling trails, swimming pools, fitness facilities, sports courts, children's play areas, retail outlets, cafés, restaurants, supermarkets, and reputable schools. Convenient access to major road networks ensures seamless connectivity across Dubai, making this remarkable villa an excellent choice for luxurious family living or a premium investment opportunity.
